<includeonly>{{Color/{{lc:{{{1|race}}} }}|{{{2|human}}} }}</includeonly><noinclude>{{delete|Unused.}}Use to figure out the color of a character from their race, group (cult,occupation,faction), rank, ajah,  or nationality.

The first parameter can be one of the groupings, second being the actual type.

For example, someone of the [[Green]] Ajah would be <nowiki>{{color|ajah|green}}</nowiki> and an [[Ogier]] would be <nowiki>{{color|race|ogier}}</nowiki>.
